findings: THE 0.60 % AND THE 8.6e-4 ARE ONE PHENOMENON, READ ON TWO FUNCTIONALS. Over 10 independent emissions of gpd/results/T-129-range-robust-placement.json, 1015 of 1042 fields are identical in every member. Every one of the 27 that vary is a descent output or a deliberate rounding: 10 are a minimax objective, 5 are a functional of a minimax argmin, 10 are T-212's two-digit departure rule and 2 is that objective rendered into a prose verdict. F1 did not fire.

THE OPTIMAL SET AT ranges[1] IS TWO-VALUED AND A FRESH RUN DRAWS FROM BOTH. 0.0365712568 in 7 of 10 member(s): iteration 30 (as committed, HEAD), fresh run A1 at HEAD, fresh run A2 at HEAD, fresh run A3 at HEAD, fresh run B1 at HEAD, fresh run B3 at HEAD, the iteration-13 tree, git-archived and run today; 0.0364754519 in 3 of 10 member(s): iteration 13 (as committed), iteration 28 (as committed), fresh run B2 at HEAD. The iteration-13 tree, git-archived and run unmodified today, lands on the reading iteration 13 did NOT emit — so nothing in the repository between then and HEAD is responsible, and the movement is a live draw rather than a one-time upstream change.

THE POINT IS 2.27x WIDER THAN THE VALUE, AND THE POINT IS NOT ONE NUMBER EITHER. At ranges[1] the objective spans 2.6197e-03 and max_i k_i spans 5.9522e-03 — and the peak SUPPORT force at the same argmin spans 7.5482e-04, 7.89x narrower than max_i k_i. Which functional of the point a file happens to emit decides how large its irreproducibility looks.

THE FOUR max_i k_i FIELDS MOVE BY THE IDENTICAL RELATIVE AMOUNT, WHICH IS THE CHECK THAT THEY ARE ONE QUANTITY: 5.952153e-03, 5.952148e-03, 5.952152e-03, 5.952151e-03. Agreement to one part in a million: true.

NO VERDICT MOVES. Of 253 boolean and 313 string fields compared — the booleans are the flatness verdicts and the strings carry every bindingStates list — 0 boolean(s) vary and 2 string(s) do: 1 of the strings differ in DIGITS ONLY — "0.0365" against "0.0366" inside predicates[1].verdict, which is CLAUDE.md's own "a moved STRING is not necessarily a moved decision" — and 1 is iteration 28's +-binds-tighter-than-.format repair, where one member still carries a RAW conversion. 0 unaccounted. F3 did not fire.

THE INPUT CHANNEL IS EXCLUDED AND THE WINNER-SELECTION CHANNEL IS NOT — WHICH IS WHAT THE ULP PROBE WAS FOR. Advancing ONE weight of ONE start by whole units in the last place, holding everything else, moves the answer by two anti-parallel 10 nm states VALUE 0.00e+00 POINT 0.00e+00; three states, the 2 nm state included VALUE 0.00e+00 POINT 0.00e+00 — the raw readings are at 1e-16 to 1e-15 and are floored: the descent is NOT chaotic in its own input. What it is sensitive to is which start wins, and that is ONE strict comparison over the terminal readings of the whole ensemble — two anti-parallel 10 nm states: 3 of 3 starts within 1 %, VALUE 5.82e-03, POINT 2.06e-02; three states, the 2 nm state included: 2 of 3 starts within 1 %, VALUE 7.23e-03, POINT 1.24e-02. A jitter that flips that comparison moves the file by the POINT width of the near-optimal set, which is the size the file shows.
